newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 6.778 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 6.778 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$85 million of 105-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.778 percent versus 6.908 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.

The bank opted to increase the acceptance level of 105-day bills to $85 million from the $75 million on offer. At the same time it only received bids for $40 million of $50 million of 385-day bills it had offered.
Across the three tranches offered, bids totalled $645 million.
